title: 第五章 剑手基础剑法第六章 磨砺特性骑士侍从
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 正如其他男侍童所想，练剑少不了身体接触。
剑室中，伊芙木剑一挑，迅步近身，肩膀轻轻一靠。
李奥被这股力量一震，直接向后飞出。
经过伊芙的测试，李奥的身体素质，可以说非常一般。
“以你现在的身体，我没什么好教你的，只能先打好基础，看好了。”伊芙紧了紧手中木剑。
“所有剑法的基础一共就三个动作，第一个，劈。”伊芙脚下一沉，踏步近身，手持木剑狠狠挥下。
伴随着一声低沉的破空声，木剑重重地落在了木人桩上。
巨大的力量通过木桩在地面上轰出一声震响。
肉眼可见的，木剑剑刃直接斩进了木桩数寸。
伊芙嘴角一勾，她很满意李奥的反应。
“第二个动作，砍！”
话音刚落，伊芙手中的木剑一收，旋即挥洒开一片剑影。
伴随木剑横斩，木桩的上半截直接像甘蔗般断裂，歪倒一边。
没等李奥反应。
伊芙脚下一动，腰间一拧，手中木剑化作一道虚影。
就像是毒蛇吐信般。
“第三个。刺!”
噗！
巨大的穿刺声夹杂着纤维断裂声。
李奥竟看到对方手中木剑直接捅穿了那粗大的木桩。
伊芙手腕一转，劲力一拧。
面前的半截木桩直接从中间一分为二，向两边爆裂开来。
伊芙手中木剑挽出一个漂亮的剑花，顺势收在背后。
她看了李奥两秒，像是等待着对方消化。
然后伊芙面无表情地将木剑随手扔给了李奥。
“这把是三斤的木剑，练吧。”
甩下一句话，伊芙头也不回，大步流星离开了练剑室。
“什么时候你能熟练使用十斤的铁剑，我再教你真正的剑法。”
将房门一关，她突然回头。
脑袋扒在门缝前，开始观察李奥的反应。
她对自己刚刚这一套剑招十分满意。
绝对能给这个少年极大的震撼，而她非常享受装比之后，看人家反应的快感。
不过，此时的李奥虽然很吃惊，但是给出的反应却没有她预想的那么激烈。
李奥只是愣了片刻，看了看手中的木剑。
的确很强，能将木剑用出这种效果，已经超出了正常人的范围。
content_en:
As the other male page boys thought, sword practice required physical contact.
In the sword room, Eve picked up her wooden sword, quickly approached, and lightly leaned on her shoulder.
Leo was shocked by the force and flew backwards.
After Eve's test, Leo's physical fitness can be said to be very average.
"With your current body, I have nothing to teach you. I can only lay a good foundation first and be careful." Eve tightened her grip on the wooden sword in her hand.
"The basis of all swordsmanship is a total of three movements. The first is to chop." Eve's feet sank, she stepped closer and swung down the wooden sword fiercely.
With a low sound of breaking through the air, the wooden sword landed heavily on the wooden man stake.
The huge force passed through the wooden pile and made a loud noise on the ground.
Visible to the naked eye, the wooden sword blade cut directly into the wooden stake several inches.
Eve curled her lips, she was very satisfied with Leo's reaction.
"Second action, chop!"
As soon as she finished speaking, Eve retracted the wooden sword in her hand, and immediately swung the sword shadow.
As the wooden sword slashed horizontally, the upper half of the wooden stake broke like sugar cane and fell to one side.
Without waiting for Leo to react.
Eve moved her feet, twisted her waist, and the wooden sword in her hand turned into a shadow.
It's like a poisonous snake spitting out a message.
"Third. Stab!"
Poof!
There was a loud piercing sound mixed with the sound of fibers breaking.
Leo actually saw the wooden sword in the opponent's hand pierce the thick wooden stake directly.
Eve turned her wrist and twisted hard.
The half wooden pile in front of him was split into two directly from the middle and exploded to both sides.
Eve pulled out a beautiful sword flower from the wooden sword in her hand and put it behind her back.
She looked at Leo for two seconds, as if waiting for him to digest.
Eve then threw the wooden sword to Leo expressionlessly.
"This is a three-pound wooden sword. Let's practice."
After saying a few words, Eve left the sword training room with long strides without looking back.
"When you become proficient in using a ten-pound iron sword, I will teach you real sword skills."
As soon as she closed the door, she suddenly turned around.
Putting his head in front of the door, he began to observe Leo's reaction.
She was very satisfied with the set of sword moves she just made.
It will definitely give this young man a great shock, and she enjoys the pleasure of watching other people's reactions after pretending to compete.
However, although Leo was surprised at this time, his reaction was not as intense as she expected.
Leo just froze for a moment and looked at the wooden sword in his hand.
It is indeed very strong. Being able to use a wooden sword to such an effect is beyond the scope of normal people.
